items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Merritt Brunies, I don't know. I'll tell you the truth, I was too young. I was too young to go out there.

ctx.x: What about the Halfway House orchestra?

Merritt Brunies, I don't know. I'll tell you the truth, I was too young. I was too young to go out there. I don't know why, but I mean, I never got around to, I never got around to the, to the the whorehouses and the, and Bourbon Street as it was.
